metadata.name: Maple Court
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A suburban cul-de-sac on a sunny late afternoon: five two-storey homes round a turning circle, each with its own layout and paint, front lawns and picket fences, back yards fenced off from the alleys with gaps and gates, a pool behind the blue house and a treehouse in the vacant lot. The court runs out onto a main street with a corner liquor store, a fenced basketball court and a burger stand with lowriders in its lot. The court crew holds the cul-de-sac end, the street crew the main street; every pane of glass breaks.
